usedFor: Booqable holds rental orders and customers, and Conversion Chats messages them through “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Reserved Order” in Booqable, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A reservation is the moment a renter wants confirmation, so the message goes out as the booking lands.

watchOut: Messages to renters reach someone outside your business, so “Send Template Message” waits in Needs you for approval.
